gameDescriptionHtml:
Embark on a new Epic Adventure in the World of Talisman – Talisman, the classic fantasy board game returns as Talisman: Digital 5th Edition. Edit the Talisman deck for the first time and customise epic adventures to play solo or with friends. Discover a world where every journey is a fresh experience in this latest digital adaptation of the beloved fantasy adventure board game. More than just a visual update, Talisman: Digital 5th Edition delivers a wealth of enhancements that elevate your adventure into the definitive, digital Talisman adaptation.

What is Talisman? – Talisman is a fantasy-themed adventure board game, first released in 1983, where you can take on the role of various adventurers, from warriors and wizards, to thieves and ghouls, each with their own strengths and unique abilities. You’ll race against each other to reach the centre of the board first, with the danger ramping up as you get closer and closer. You’ll fight strong enemies, gain valuable treasure, cast awesome spells, and encounter mysterious strangers on your journey. You’ll need a good mixture of luck and strategy, and to balance risk and reward if you want to emerge the victor!

What’s New in Talisman: Digital 5th Edition? – In Talisman: Digital 5th Edition, the eleventh era has just dawned – the three Great Gods who originally created the Crown of Command have faded into myth. A new champion must rise to claim the Crown and rule the world in the era to come. Will you be that champion?

Craft Your Own Adventure! – The biggest new feature in Talisman: Digital 5th Edition is the Deck Editor, which allows you to fully customise your Talisman experience by adding, removing and adjusting the cards you’ll encounter during your game. Save your created decks, play them with your friends online and unleash your creativity with billions of possible combinations, and more being added with each expansion.

Join the Adventure Today – Whether you’re a seasoned Talisman veteran or a newcomer to the world of fantasy board games, Talisman: Digital 5th Edition will offer an unforgettable journey filled with magic, mystery, and endless possibilities. Are you ready to claim the Crown of Command once and for all? Or will you be turned into a toad again?

Contains: Talisman: Digital 5th Edition – The Reaper Classic; Talisman: Digital 5th Edition – The Frostmarch Classic; Talisman: Digital 5th Edition – Alliances: Fate Beckons; Talisman: Digital 5th Edition – The Ranger Character; Talisman: Digital 5th Edition – The Swordsman Character; Talisman: Digital 5th Edition – The Jester Character; Talisman: Digital 5th Edition Soundtrack.

Game Features

  • Solo or Multiplayer: Play alone against AI opponents or gather your friends for epic multiplayer battles, online or locally.
  • Expansive Content: Choose from a vast array of characters, each with their own unique abilities, and explore a richly detailed world filled with countless adventures and challenges.
  • Customizable Experience: Tailor your gameplay experience with the new Deck Editor, various house rules and more ways to customise your Talisman adventure.
  • Revamped Rules: Experience Talisman with updated rules that streamline gameplay, enhancing strategic depth, and ensuring a more balanced and engaging experience for players both old and new.
  • Modern Design: Enjoy a sleek and intuitive interface designed for seamless navigation and effortless immersion, whether you’re playing solo or competing with friends online.
  • Remastered Classic Expansions: With The Reaper and The Frostmarch already available, we’re fully remaking your 4th Edition expansions as new, 5th Edition versions, free for anyone who owns the original expansions in Talisman: Digital Classic Edition!

Included DLCs:

  • The Reaper Classic
  • The Frostmarch Classic
  • Alliances: Fate Beckons
  • The Ranger Character
  • The Swordsman Character
  • The Jester Character
  • Four Classic Corners Pass
  • The City Classic
  • Soundtrack
